View All Spaces

180 Studios is the perfect venue for a diverse range of events, including large conferences of up to 2000 guests, major exhibitions, brand activations or intimate private dinners.

Dining

Exceptional culinary experiences

Take advantage of our talented team of world class Star Chefs to provide them with an unforgettable gastronomic experience.

Audiovisual Support

180's extensive range of cutting-edge equipment is key in bring your event to life or producing any type of content. Our offerings include top-of-the-line screens, lighting, sound systems, cameras and microphones ensuring maximum impact.

Masterful Design

Our spaces are designed to foster a warm and welcoming environment, featuring a curated selection of designer furniture from renowned creators such as Charlotte Perriand, George Nakashima, Ettore Sottsass, Le Corbusier, and Joe Colombo, among others.

State-of-the art production facilities

180 offers a comprehensive suite of state-of-the-art equipment tailored for high-quality content production across photography, video, and audio. Our production studios include leading-edge cameras, microphones, lighting setups, sound systems, and high-resolution screens, all designed to enhance the visual and auditory impact of your projects.
